event: Shell TotalEnergies and Eni sell OML 18 to Eroton; Shell sells OML 24 to Newcross
Awoba field shut in after evacuation problems and crude theft
Navy finds crude tapping on OML 18 well 17 at Elem Krakama creek
NNPC replaces Eroton with NNPC Eighteen Operating Limited as OML 18 operator
Alakiri well 9T spill and wellhead fire (burns to December 2024)
Awoba unit restarts production (NNPC and Newcross); VIIRS flaring at Awoba resumes
Akaso well 4 wellhead fire at Krakrama (burns to January 2025)
EMIT methane plume 565 kg/h at Buguma Creek wells 3 and 10
Gas and oil leak begins at OML 18 Buguma well 8 (Agum)
EMIT methane plume 1918 kg/h 350 m from Buguma well 8
Buguma well 8 wellhead blows out; fire from 12 January to 12 February 2025
Troops find tapping on Akaso well 14 and 17 flowline at Tuma and Krakrama
Newcross restores Ekulama-16L (shut in since 1993) and prepares gas compressors on OML 24
Troops arrest suspects tampering with Krakama wellhead 12 at Bille
FSO Cawthorne commissioned offshore Bonny for OML 18 exports
NOSDRA record: equipment failure and crude release at Awoba well 6 (Newcross)
Gas bubbling first reported at Opu Osia creek south of Bille Town
NOSDRA formally notified of the Bille gas seepage
NOSDRA air tests: methane 10000 times background at one site; CH4 VOCs and H2S detected
EMIT pass over Bille (83% cloud): enhancement up to 1100 ppm·m over the western town
Fire at a water mono pump in Bille; NUPRC and minister announce investigation
NUPRC: first aquifer contaminated; methane along a 1.5 km stretch; international firm engaged
House of Representatives hearing; NUPRC says gas migrates from deep reservoirs and no link to facilities
FSO Cawthorne first commercial loading (950000 bbl Cawthorne Blend)
